events.title: Josh Pyke — Live at The Triffid
events.description: Acclaimed Australian singer-songwriter Josh Pyke performs his folk-tinged indie pop live at The Triffid, one of Brisbane's premier intimate music venues.

events.title: Chat Pile + Beastwars — Live at The Triffid
events.description: Oklahoma experimental noise/post-metal band Chat Pile teams up with New Zealand heavyweights Beastwars for an intense, critically acclaimed underground rock double-bill at The Triffid.

events.title: The QUBE Effect — Triffid Residency
events.description: A recurring Sunday residency at The Triffid throughout June 2026, showcasing emerging local talent from The QUBE Effect program.

events.title: Black Bear Lodge — Free Live Music
events.datetime: Fri 12 Jun & Sat 13 Jun, from 8:00 PM
events.description: Enjoy free live music from local and touring acts at Black Bear Lodge, a stylish candlelit hideaway known for its intimate atmosphere and diverse music program.

events.title: Platform 2026: Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie & Seren Wagstaff
events.datetime: Tue 9 Jun – Sun 14 Jun, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: IMA's annual exhibition showcasing ambitious new projects by three Queensland emerging artists: Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff, exploring themes like cultural heritage and material processes.

events.title: Mandy Quadrio: Kukunna Wurraweena
events.datetime: Tue 9 Jun – Sun 14 Jun, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: A specially commissioned contemporary art project by Mandy Quadrio, part of the IMA's Commissioners Circle initiative, offering a unique perspective through her distinctive artistic voice.

events.title: Avid Reader Bookshop — Book Clubs & Author Events
events.description: Brisbane's much-loved independent bookshop hosts various book clubs and author talks throughout the week, offering intellectually engaging discussions and opportunities to connect with fellow readers.
